systems.tiers: not stated; the Cadastro Social Único uses civil identification as a rule and its biometrics are to interoperate with it where possible (art. 26)

note: The founding decree of the single social registry, which is a social-protection register outside the study's classes. Birth registration appears only as a duty on provincial managers to develop strategies for access to civil documentation, preferably birth registration (art. 11); nothing on how civil registration offices make the record.
